Surface materials: broad flat riverside paving, trimmed grass strips only at the outside borders, distant water at the top edge and tiny plain park furniture. High camera directly above with only a slight consistent top-down view on edge props, no horizon, no isometric room cutaway. The central roughly seventy percent is clear low-contrast flat playable ground; decorative objects, water, raised structures and vegetation stay at the outer margins. Every ground region remains visually continuous and traversable, no walls dividing combat lanes. Hand-painted modern Korean city texture, restrained navy shadows and soft warm highlights, full opaque image to all edges, no player, monster, weapon, UI, text, logos, giant gate portal, repeated tile grid or camera-perspective vanishing point.
useKo: 향후 군집·범위 중심의 맵·웨이브를 검토하는 미구현 배경 기획입니다. 현재 광화문 맵·충돌·카메라·진행 기록을 변경하지 않으며 원화 승인 후 별도 콘텐츠 설계가 필요합니다.
